subject: Banking
title: PayPal Started the Revolution
description: A quick win: understand PayPal Started the Revolution.

hook.text: PayPal launched in 1998 to let people email money. It processed $1.36 trillion in payments in 2023.

buildup.text: PayPal solved online trust. Strangers could transact safely with PayPal in the middle.

discovery.text: PayPal proved that payments could happen outside the banking system.

twist.text: PayPal's 'mafia' — founders who left — started Tesla, YouTube, LinkedIn, Palantir, and Yelp.

climax.text: PayPal proved there was a market between banks and consumers. That gap became the fintech industry.

punchline.text: $1.36 trillion in payments. PayPal proved fintech could rival banks.

quiz.question: How much did PayPal process in payments in 2023?
